title: Macro Annual
description: Real GDP ABMI, quarterly national accounts
notes:
Fiscal April–March: quarterly flows sum Q2–Q1, divide £m by 1000; rates average four quarterly values. ABMI real GDP growth is year-on-year fiscal sum growth. CAER PNFC GOS is seasonally adjusted current-price £m. Bank Rate IUMABEDR monthly averages average April–March. GDP: OBR databank AE. Missing early observations are empty, never interpolated. All source_ids enumerate exact fetched series.
